note: Small, quiet rustic campground on the southeast shore of 43-acre Cunard Lake, an electric-motors-only, slow-no-wake lake whose outlet creek to Sweeney Lake suits canoes. Sandy swimming beach with steps; boat landing beside the entrance. Designated quiet campground: no generators or other noise-producing devices. --Claude
summary: NHAL rustic page and the DNR brochure/map read; GoingToCamp unread (refuses). 33 sites (27 drive-in, 6 walk-to tent), no electricity, vault toilets, hand pumps, all reservable, no generators. Lakeview confirmed. Pin ~360 m east of the campground; re-pin proposed. Stored website dead.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview confirmed (no --AWH). The brochure map puts the campground on the east side of the lake; the drive-in sites nearest the water are 1124, 1126 and 1127 on the lake side of the loop road, with the walk-to tent sites 1120-1123 down at the shore. On leaf-off Esri imagery the shore is lined by a band of conifers about 15-25 m deep and the loops are in mixed forest behind it; no drive-in pad is on open ground within about 50 m of the water. A filtered view from the lake-side sites supports lakeview; no change.
